title: Update on recent cybersecurity incident
summary: Learn more about the incident here.
body_markdown:
On August 25, Boston Scientific identified a cybersecurity incident affecting certain information technology systems that resulted in a network outage and disruption to the company’s operations. Once detected, the company activated incident response protocols and began an investigation to assess and contain the threat with the assistance of third-party cybersecurity experts. The incident has impacted access to certain operating systems and business applications, including the ability to process and ship customer orders.


The investigation into the cybersecurity incident is ongoing. While the company is working diligently to restore affected functions and systems access, the timeline for a full restoration is not yet known.


The company filed[an 8k](https://www.sec.gov/ix?doc=/Archives/edgar/data/885725/000088572526000056/bsx-20260826.htm) on this incident and will provide updates on this webpage as appropriate.
